overview: This paper proposes a theoretical framework based on In-Context Learning (ICL) to explain why Continuous Adversarial Training (CAT) works for LLMs, and introduces Embedding-Regularized Continuous AT (ER-CAT) which improves the robustness-utility tradeoff by regularizing the singular values of the embedding matrix.

modules.name: LSA-E Theoretical Simulator
modules.description: Implements the Linear Self-Attention with Embedding (LSA-E) architecture and the logic for deriving the surrogate ICL embedding AT objective and calculating the theoretical robust generalization bounds.

modules.name: Embedding Singular Value Regularizer
modules.description: Computes the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of the language model's embedding matrix and calculates the variance of its singular values to serve as the regularization term in ER-CAT.

modules.name: Embedding Space PGD Attack
modules.description: Implements Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) in the continuous embedding space to generate adversarial perturbations for the input token embeddings during the training phase.

modules.name: ER-CAT Loss Aggregator
modules.description: Constructs the full adversarial training objective by combining the toward/away adversarial losses, utility loss, loss cut-off mechanisms, and the embedding singular value variance regularization term.

modules.name: Safety and Utility Data Loader
modules.description: Loads and preprocesses the safety datasets (Harmbench, AdvBench) and utility datasets (UltraChat), formatting them into tokenized sequences paired with targeted responses and safe responses.

modules.name: LoRA Adversarial Training Controller
modules.description: Manages the training loop for ER-CAT, handling batch sampling strategies (mixing adversarial and utility data), parameter updates, and the application of LoRA specifically to the embedding layer and attention projections.

modules.name: Token-Level Attack Generators
modules.description: Implements gradient-based and heuristic token-level suffix attacks (GCG, BEAST, GCQ, AutoDAN) used to evaluate the jailbreak robustness of the trained models.

modules.name: Prompt-Level Attack Generators
modules.description: Implements human-crafted and agent-based prompt-level attacks (DeepInception, PAIR) used to evaluate robustness against semantic jailbreaks without token optimization.

modules.name: Robustness Metric Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) under repeated query settings (Avg@5 and 1@5) by interacting with the target model and an LLM-based judger to classify response harmfulness.

modules.name: Utility Metric Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluates the model's utility using Length-Controlled WinRate (LC-WinRate) by comparing generated responses against a reference model using an automated evaluation framework.

modules.name: Experiment Analyzer and Visualizer
modules.description: Orchestrates ablation studies on hyperparameters (perturbation radius, regularization coefficient), logs the dynamics of embedding matrix singular values during training, and generates performance comparison tables and plots.
